thread:
nia: Quick heads-up — onboarding sample app produced repeated webhook deliveries after a 429 during token rotation. Repro summary: client -> 429 -> SDK refresh -> immediate retry -> downstream saw two completions.
sam: Ugh. Can you paste a minimal log snippet? Wondering if SDK retried immediately or server replayed.
nia: Short log (sanitized): `OUT: POST /v1/generate id=req-5a bodyHash=0xabc` -> `IN: 429 {"error":"rate_limited"}` -> SDK: `auth.refresh()` -> `OUT: POST /v1/generate id=req-5a bodyHash=0xabc` -> `IN: 200 {"id":"gen_001"}`. Webhook got gen_001 and gen_002 ~160ms later.
sam: So server accepted multiple attempts. Did sample app attach an idempotency header for generate calls?
nia: No, we only set idempotency for payments flows. We assumed safe-replay heuristics would suffice for onboarding.
olivia: Two-pronged approach: immediate user guidance + SDK mitigations. Quick mitigation: update sample app to set `Idempotency-Key` per user-visible generation request (derived from user_id + body-hash). Long term: SDK should avoid blind immediate retry after auth refresh (jitter/backoff) and optionally provide a tiny transient dedupe.
sam: Agree. Proposed SDK changes: (A) add default post-refresh jitter = 100 ±50ms (configurable via opts/env), (B) emit diagnostic event `sdk.retry.post_refresh` with hashed_body and attempt index, (C) opt-in transient in-memory dedupe cache storing only body-hash -> response-id for TTL=1500ms behind `enableTransientDedupe=false` by default, (D) leader-lock per-process opt-in to coalesce concurrent refresh/ retry.
olivia: Important: exempt streaming/resume flows from jitter/dedupe — resume needs immediate retry semantics. Also ensure memory caps for dedupe cache (max_keys=5000 by default).
nia: Sounds good. I'll open a tiny PR to sample app to add the `Idempotency-Key` header and include a short repro script for SRE.
sam: I'll file an SDK issue for jitter + telemetry + optional dedupe/leader-lock and propose env flags: `RW_SDK_POST_REFRESH_DELAY_MS`, `RW_SDK_POST_REFRESH_JITTER_MS`, `RW_SDK_ENABLE_TRANSIENT_DEDUPE`, `RW_SDK_DEDUPE_TTL_MS`.
olivia: For defaults, keep jitter small: delay=100, jitter=50, dedupe disabled by default. Leader-lock off by default (enableRefreshLeaderLock=false) since it only helps single-process scenarios.
telemetry-bot: created issue #8201: "sdk: post-auth refresh jitter + transient dedupe + telemetry to reduce duplicate accepts"
sam: Also add a note in the onboarding checklist: "If request triggers external side-effects (webhooks, emails), include an Idempotency-Key or ensure server-side dedupe; client heuristics reduce risk but are not a substitute."
nia: Will link #8201 in the PR and include the repro harness. SRE: can you run a quick validation once that lands?
olivia: Yes — include a short test plan: 10k cycles with coordinated token expiry and assert duplicates <=1 per 1000. We'll tune if needed.
sam: One more: improve SDK logs to show a `retry_after_auth_refresh` tag so customers and SRE can trace origin of retries.
nia: Thanks all. I'll push the sample app patch and repro, and label the SDK issue with "high-signal". :thumbsup:
